info.title: Paysafe Payments API
info.description: The Payments API is the single REST integration point for accepting card payments, bank transfers, wallets and local payment methods. It supersedes the legacy Cards API for new integrations.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Manage webhook subscriptions and inspect delivery attempts.
